frequency_question: How often do treaties of this class successfully renew prior to expiration when preliminary technical committee meetings are observable in the preceding months?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral river or water resource treaties with fixed multi-decade durations that reached an expiration or mandatory renewal juncture. Excludes trade agreements, security pacts, and domestic legislation.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation extensions and permanent mechanisms
Columbia River Treaty regime reviews and operational renewals
1996 Mahakali Treaty framework between India and Nepal
Helsinki Rules and subsequent riparian framework renewals in Eastern Europe
U.S.-Mexico Water Treaty boundary adjustments and minute signings
Senegal River Basin Development Organization charter renewals

coverage_note: 7 named; estimated approximately 12 major bilateral water treaty renewals globally since 1970 meeting these structural criteria
known_gaps: Some minor bilateral accords lapse quietly without public technical precursor signals, but major foundational treaties nearly always exhibit visible bureaucratic preparatory signaling.
skeleton: Global transboundary water treaty renewals with active technical committee precursors in the final 12-month window
multiplier: 6 hits out of 7 comparable named historical precedents with visible technical precursors
validity_reason: Bilateral water diplomacy norms and bureaucratic operational cadences remain stable across multi-year cycles.
